note: P is four bottom-right dark multi-package lists sharing one palette (near-identical #0c0e12 / #161920 surfaces, blue accent) and an add-form footer; P3 (monospace, ledger rows) and P4 (accordion timeline) are the main departures. Q is four single-parcel vertical timelines with Copy/Open/Dismiss actions, with Q2 and Q3 nearly identical, but Q4 uses a horizontal progress bar and Q1, Q2 and Q3 use different accents (amber, green, neutral) and reopen patterns, so the set spreads a little further.
